caption:
Your quote request form probably asks for a name, number, and "tell us about your project."

That open text box is why your team spends ten minutes on the phone with someone who was just curious.

A 3-question quiz fixes it. Service type, timeline, budget stage. Each tap tags the lead and routes it automatically: urgent leads go straight to a call task, researchers go to nurture.

Example workflow above. Illustrative, not a live client funnel.

DM TRIAL
#LeadQualification #ServiceBusiness #ContractorMarketing #CRMAutomation #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels are the current engagement and save leader for B2B, and a labeled quiz-funnel qualification walkthrough is an unclaimed demonstration distinct from every prior follow-up, review, and reactivation system already shipped.
